metadata.description: There are reports that there is a huge gap in the vaccination drives between tribal and non tribal areas in various states of India. Today we will discuss this issue with the representatives of different adivasi communities from Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Bihar, Gujarat, and Jharkhand. We will try to understand what is the ground reality in the adivasi areas of these states.
